scope: Ntgre recursive LegacyPlatform declarations only; external stacks and production are outside this ledger
notes: Nested-stack handles are already included in the 2621 declarations; the root is not an extra resource row.

61 stateful declarations follow the source definition: tables, buckets, keys and Cognito pool. The 62 protected identities also include AppSync. IAM, nested stacks and other resources may still be high risk.
An independent read proof does not migrate or retire a Legacy declaration. All rows remain LEGACY_ACTIVE and NOT_ELIGIBLE.
No API key value is stored: only its recorded identity hash.
Full-account/external runtime ownership and production require separate evidence before migration completion.
